_doc: Role -> ordered lanes for the free swarm kitchen (Plan B). Each lane is (provider, model). Every role ends in the local Ollama floor so it can never run out of capacity. privacy=sensitive roles are restricted to no-train lanes (groq/cerebras/nvidia) or local; privacy=public_ok roles may use training-on-input lanes (gemini/mistral) because they only see public scraped pages. Provider API keys live in gitignored per-provider key files, NEVER here. Spec: markdown/planning/FREE-AGENT-PLAN-B-KITCHEN.md sec 7.
_local_note: qwen3.6:35b (MoE 3B-active) benched 2026-07-08 on the RTX 5080 box: json_ok TRUE both directions, ~78 tok/s, ~69s COLD load (23GB). On SMALL-PROMPT R&D roles only (strategist/coder/validator). Chef REVERTED to qwen3:14b same night: a ~4K-token prompt crashed the 35b llama-server (0xc0000409 CUDA buffer overrun -- 23GB weights + KV cache too tight on 16GB VRAM / 32GB RAM), and chef prompts run ~31K tokens; the 14b floor holds big context reliably. Hot-path veto roles (coordinator, critic -- heartbeat_core entry sanity-check) also stay on qwen3:14b (2.6s load) so a cold 35b load can never eat a market-tick veto timeout. Doctrine: markdown/planning/BRAIN-SOVEREIGNTY.md sec 6 + G6 (RAM ceiling). REPOINTED 2026-08-29: strategist/coder/validator ollama floors moved 35b -> qwen3:14b. The 35b was never reachable in practice (all 84 local calls over 08-26..08-28 were qwen3:14b) and a fallback that fires would try to load 22GB of weights on a 16GB-VRAM / 31GB-RAM box with 7.5GB free disk -- i.e. the exact CPU/RAM thrash J reported. Every role now floors on the one local model this box is documented to run reliably. REVERT: set those 3 lanes back to qwen3.6:35b.

Real spend was ~$9.47 total (chef/coder ~$9.30, coordinator ~$0.17) before the 07-06 partial fix; NO role lane references this provider anymore (last one, 'coordinator', removed 07-08). key_file left pointing at the ORIGINAL path (.groq.key) DELIBERATELY -- the actual key was moved to .groq.key.disabled (same dir), so this path now resolves to nothing and _load_key() returns None: any future/undiscovered 'groq:' spec fails closed (key_load_failed) instead of silently billing. Do not re-enable without re-verifying the account is back on a hard-capped free tier -- to re-enable: rename .groq.key.disabled back to .groq.key.
